news.title: With a focus on the Great Lakes, UW faculty and staff reflect on the Wisconsin Idea
news.summary_en: This year's Wisconsin Ideas Seminar highlighted the ancient waterways of Wisconsin and how they continue to sustain life and community across the state.

news.title: The iconic campus clock
news.summary_en: Before the era of cellphones and smartwatches, Music Hall’s 100-foot-high clock tower was one of the only places on campus to reference the official time.
